name: Modal List → Detail
description: Guidance for opening contextual record detail from a directory Table into a modal host that composes the non-modal governed Side Panel without changing the Side Panel public API.

structure.role: Open contextual detail from a genuine interactive control in the Table Action region; the Table row itself remains non-activating.
A composition-owned modal host overlays the active workspace, owns modality/focus/background behavior, and contains the governed Side Panel.
The governed Side Panel supplies the detail surface regions, scrolling body, anchored actions, and optional close affordance while remaining non-modal itself.
Use governed Dialog for a nested consequential confirmation; while it is open, Dialog owns the active modal focus/keyboard interaction.

layout.statement: Overlay contextual detail above the existing directory; do not create a sibling column that squeezes or reflows the directory beside the Side Panel.
When composed inside Application Shell, begin the modal detail host below the governed persistent Top Navbar and use the governed top-height value.
Use the governed detail available-width/Side Panel width authority rather than inventing a competing panel width.
Side Panel fills the available modal-host block size so its governed body owns scrolling and its actions remain anchored.

responsive.statement: Current evidence governs the modal Side Panel composition for wide/available detail presentation only.
Do not invent a narrow drawer, full-page detail, or alternate navigation model without approved product evidence or future composition guidance; escalate the narrow behavior as unresolved.

direction.statement: Attach contextual detail to logical inline-end using logical properties so physical placement mirrors in RTL.
Intrinsic-LTR product values inside detail, such as emails and project keys, may isolate their own text direction without forcing the panel or host LTR.

accessibility.statement: The composition-owned host exposes modal dialog semantics; the nested Side Panel remains its governed named non-modal region and must not gain aria-modal.
While detail is open, make the background shell inert and unavailable to assistive technology.
Move focus into the detail host when it opens and keep keyboard focus contained within the active modal host.
When detail closes, restore focus to the record action that opened it when that trigger still exists.

behavior.statement: Escape requests closure of the modal detail host when no nested governed Dialog currently owns modal interaction.
Backdrop activation may close the contextual detail host only when the product interaction explicitly adopts that behavior; Side Panel itself does not own backdrop dismissal.
Keep the corresponding Table row selected while its contextual detail is open; this remains contextual association rather than bulk selection.
When a governed Dialog opens from detail, suspend competing host focus/Escape handling until the Dialog closes.

allowed.statement: Local composition CSS may create the overlay host and logical inline-end placement because modality/placement are intentionally outside Side Panel ownership.
Local composition CSS may flatten the Side Panel radii that physically meet the viewport edge when product evidence requires that attachment.
A local composition shadow is allowed only when product/Figma evidence supplies it because the current elevation tokens do not define shadow values.

forbidden: adding modal, trapFocus, restoreFocus, escapeToClose, or backdrop props to Side Panel
making the entire Table row an activation target
placing Side Panel beside the directory in a shrinking split layout
inventing narrow-screen detail behavior from Storybook or prototype source
allowing the outer host and nested Dialog to compete for focus trapping or Escape
